children: Enova International is proposing a $500,026,000 private offering of Series 2026-1 fixed-rate asset-backed notes backed by a revolving pool of OnDeck small business loans.
Proposed private offering of $500,026,000 aggregate principal of Series 2026-1 fixed-rate notes by OnDeck Asset Securitization IV.
Collateral will be a revolving pool of small business term loans and lines of credit originated or purchased by OnDeck; notes may be issued in multiple classes.
Issuer (the securitization vehicle) will be sole obligor; notes are not obligations or guarantees of Enova or OnDeck.
Net proceeds will be used by the Issuer to buy loans from OnDeck; Enova will use amounts received for general corporate purposes.
Supplemental historic loan performance data (Exhibit 99.1) provided to qualified institutional buyers and non-U.S. investors under Rule 144A and Regulation S.
